### documents.json[199] — Managed Database: handling external retention allocation
## Business purpose
Managed Database external retention allocation supports the requested account correction. This reconciliation applies when the customer requests correction of the retained-storage entitlement record for a closed service period, identified by an existing authorization request. It changes only nonfinancial service entitlements; historical invoices are not adjusted and no money movement is implied. Complete the existing pending assessment named by its external reference, with exactly one update per assessment. The assessment external reference is External retention allocation.

## Capability
Record the externally protected portion of retained database storage. Replace the database retention assessment's quantity and set its status to completed. A completed receipt confirms that the corrected entitlement is recorded and available to account readers.

## Invocation
record_external_retention_8927a6d4 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of a database retention assessment record, obtained from find_database_events.
- quantity: Decimal — Assessed retained capacity; unit GB-month. Decimal quantity to six decimal places; round half-up once at submission, with no empty value.

## Successful return
A string receipt containing database_event_id (assessment reference string), quantity (GB-month decimal with six places), and completed status, confirming the assessment was updated.

### documents.json[14] — Managed Backup: backup and restore meter calculation
For Managed Backup, the backup and restore meter calculation basis governs charge posting, supplemental meter recording, nonfinancial service recording.

## Policy clauses

The reference protected capacity in GB defines a price band rather than included protection.

Primary usage measures actual protected GB-month at primary unit rate.

Retained backup storage bills retained GB-month beyond included storage multiple times the primary protected quantity at excess backup storage rate.

Ingestion uses incremental ingestion rate per incremental GB; remote copy transfer uses remote copy transfer rate per copied GB; immutable storage uses immutable copy storage rate per GB-month.

The customer chooses standard or rapid restore for a source restore request: standard restore charges restored GB at standard restore rate only after the included number of completed standard restores in that calendar month, and rapid restore always uses rapid restore rate.

Restore requests are distinct by source reference and completion time; an uncompleted restore has no usage charge.

Export uses export processing rate per processed GB.

A customer-selected immutable copy cannot be disposed before its recorded lock expiration; the default retention for ordinary copies is default ordinary-copy retention period.

Early deletion retention billing charges remaining minimum charged immutable retention period less authoritative age in calendar days, floored at zero, times deleted GB and immutable copy storage rate divided by actual dates in the deletion month.

This retention billing applies only where an allowed policy retention reduction deletes a copy after its lock expires; it never authorizes breaking an immutable lock.

Actual configured retention and age are recorded separately.

For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under tax rules.

An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are not covered by policy instead of guessed prices.

These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

The unrounded ancillary subtotal is the positive remainder of measured quantity after the applied inclusion, floored at zero, multiplied by the selected ancillary unit rate.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The reference protected capacity in GB defines a price band rather than included protection.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical permitted retention reduction deletes an immutable copy after its recorded lock expires. The minimum charged retention is 18 days, authoritative age is 12 days, deleted quantity is 10 GB, storage rate is USD 0.06 per GB-month, and the deletion month contains 30 dates. The unrounded retention amount is USD 0.12: the remaining 6 days are multiplied by 10 GB and USD 0.06, then divided by 30. If authoritative age instead reaches 18 days, the remaining retention amount is zero. These hypothetical values neither define tier rates nor authorize deletion before lock expiry.
